rule_outs: Dwelling 7 m from the best section
summary: Campus lane where cars park nose to kerb; student housing around.
reasons: Other cars park along this kerb
Dormitories 26 m or more away here
Students overlook it from all sides

drivers.seclusion: Mapped dormitories lie 26 m or more from this section, but residential college buildings sit all round within about 30 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lane with parking bays and cars already parked along the west edge; a van would fit among them.
drivers.traffic: Low-speed campus lane serving college car parks; some traffic day and night.
drivers.convention: Rows of cars parked along the kerb, so a van would not stand out.

flags: Steep: about 7% over 30-55 m, 16% max on the climb from the start
Mapped dormitory only 5 m away from 60 m onwards
Mapped private parking right beside the lane
sun_shade: Mostly open; building on the west gives afternoon shade, trees shade the south end.
cannot_judge: Whether the lane is private college parking

best_section.where: west side of the lane, beside the long flat-roofed building, before the parked-car rows
